question: Does faster learning of only the zero-initialized spatial residual scale allow a useful branch to emerge?

changes.cab: Identical Stage50 CAB architecture; only384channel residual-scale parameters use LR1e-3 instead of1e-4.
changes.conv_control: Identical Stage50 fixed-channel convolution architecture; identical gate-only LR intervention.

insertion: encoder.model.levels[2].blocks[3].mlp output hook; input is norm2(post-SSM residual), before subsequent Attention blocks
mapping: Use original native window_reverse to28x28, crop real16x16, apply local module, zero-pad back28x28, native window_partition14. No processing of artificial padding in CAB.
original_encoder: Official MambaVision-S ImageNet initialization; original SSM equations, all MLPs, original14/7windows retained; only stages3/4 and adapter trainable, encoder.eval.
initialization: Original encoder/head states and logits exactly match reference; native CAB init isolated CPU seed142; residual scale exactly0.

training.precision: BF16_forward_FP32_loss; residual cast back to common dtype
training.clipping: decoder norm1; combined all trainable encoder parameters including adapter and gate norm1, original traversal order

reference: Stage45 UPer64 and both Stage50 same-architecture controls; replay all3x762validation exactly before reuse.
selection: Max validation macroDice earliesttie; complete100epochs; full867test for every fixedbest checkpoint after both trainings.

evidence.note: Convolution weights changed15-35%; branch is trained but makes small inference contribution. Conditional interventions are not retraining ablations. No test used for choice.

controls: One optimizer-factor intervention. Preserve original decoder clipping and combined encoder+adapter clipping; do not clip the new gate group separately.
caveats: Module adaptation, not full MambaIR reproduction or new CAB invention.
No change to SSM state update equation; this is a Mamba-block spatial branch.
Single seed and single location; no claim all spatial alternatives are exhausted if negative.
Rank8 PEFT failure does not exclude other PEFT ranks, learning rates or placements.
Repeatedly exposed test cannot support a new untouched-test claim.
hypothesis: Small branch contribution may reflect slow residual-scale learning OR lack of useful features; increasing LR is a test, not a proven correction.
stop_rule: If contribution becomes stronger without validation gain, do not continue tuning this insertion; investigate a different measured limitation.
